name: create-pull-request
description: Opens a GitHub pull request from a head branch into a base branch, optionally as a draft with a Markdown body, and answers its number, which github__get-pull-request takes. The owner and repository come from github__list-my-repositories, whose default_branch is the usual base.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

head.description: Branch containing the changes, or owner:branch for a fork.

draft.description: Whether to open the pull request as a draft.
